reason: Source v1.24.0 already caps local RisingWave memory (2 GiB single_node budget, Docker limit 1 GiB above it, compactor limit from a mounted config), so the older 2 GiB container / 1.5 GiB budget hunk is not ported. Local fixture settings on a shared busy disk: [system] checkpoint_frequency = 5 (at every barrier the 54-step bootstrap was fsync-bound), time_travel_retention_ms = 0 (nothing reads AS OF), [meta] max_heartbeat_interval_secs = 300 (2026-11-14: the meta store waited 8 s for SQLite connections, probably on the shared disk's latency spike (not verified), the compute node expired after 60 s without a heartbeat, recovery rejected its SSTs as invalid and the process exited), and the SQLite meta store in a 256 MiB tmpfs added to the container limit; the state store stays on the container disk. Superseded: the first version put the whole state store in a 2 GiB tmpfs (it grew to 1.5 GB and was swapped out), the second had only the [system] settings. Web, seed and queries unchanged.
